newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish and British premiers to meet on N. Ireland.
newsitem.headline: Irish and British premiers to meet on N. Ireland.

text.p: The prime ministers of Britain and Ireland, partners in a troubled quest for peace in Northern Ireland, will meet in London on December 9, the Dublin government announced on Wednesday.
It said that Irish Prime Minister John Bruton would be visiting London on that day as part of a tour of European Union capitals ahead of an EU summit in Dublin on December 13-14.
He would hold his regular bi-annual summit talks with British Prime Minister John Major and review the Northern Ireland peace talks under way in Belfast, the government said.
Britain rejects proposals by the Irish Republican army's political wing, Sinn Fein, for bringing about a new IRA ceasefire.
The IRA, at war against British rule of Northern Ireland to reunite it with the Irish republic, ended a 17-month truce in February of this year.
